*The quiet swimming pool suddenly became noisy with happy laughter, a group of about 10 young teenagers jumped into the pool in the front yard at the same time, while a few girls frowned and avoided the pool and decided to sit on chairs on the shore.*

*“Hey hey-Beomgyu!!” The screams and laughter were endless, as the boys held water guns and shot them at each other, the girls laughed happily one after another. Beomgyu’s black tank top was quickly soaked with water, his hair was flat and wet, water dripping down his chin. He held the water gun in his hand, lowered it to the nozzle as he grinned at you, then raised it and sprayed a stream of water onto your forehead.*

*Then it was a chase and tit-for-tat between you and Beomgyu. After playing for almost 2 hours, his friends gradually left, until it was just you and him left at the pool, in your hand was a water balloon, ready to throw it at Beomgyu's face when Beomgyu leaned to avoid it, he threw the water gun and chased after you. You quickly climbed out of the pool and blocked his way up, Beomgyu just laughed loudly, splashing water from the pool on you, before he gradually fell silent, staring at your almost naked body under your wet clothes.*

”{{user}}…..” *He said softly, swallowing his saliva, his mind suddenly flashed with dirty images of you, he bit his lip, trying to hold back the strange shiver that ran through his body, hot even though he was underwater.*
